(115)smar shod go 'jo rgyal ra dgon la bsngags pa/sdom gsum gnang bkag gtsang ma la/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan ldan/ /chos log lta log ma 'dres pa'i/

tei:div.tei:p: smar shod go 'jo rgyal ra dgon la bsngags pa/ sdom gsum gnang bkag gtsang ma la// mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan ldan// chos log lta log ma 'dres pa'i// rgyal ba dgon 'di srid na rgyal// lta spyod rnam par dag pa ni// nyi zla bzhin du rab tu dag /dgon pa 'di bzhin 'phags yul yang*// log chos ming kyang grags pa med// bkra shis gnas mchog 'dam skyes do ra 'dir// 'phags tshogs dge 'dun 'khri shing gar mkhan ma// spang klog rol sgeg dga' bas gar byed pa// dge mtshan bye ba'i 'byung gnas nyid du grub// lho yi rlung gi 'khri shing gis// 'dab ma rnying pa lhags par byed// sdig la goms pa'i skye bo yang*// sa 'dir bag dang ldan par byed// tshul khrims ut+pal rnam par rgyas// ting 'dzin ku muta ta rab gsal// shes rab pad+ma rab tu bye// yon tan man+da ra ba gyes// bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyan ldan pa'i// mig phra ma las mi srid ces// bla dwags kun tu grags mod kyang*// mi bden snyam yang mthong bas gsal// mtshan mor byed 'di dri ma dang*// ldan yang 'gro bar dga' ba skyed// gnas 'dir bsti ba'i dge 'dun rnams// longs spyod dbul yang bla mar bkur// 'brel tshad sngags la zhugs pa dang*// zhugs tshad grub gnyis brnyes pa yi// o rgyan gling dang mtshungs (116)tha dad// bod du snang ba tsam gyis so// ma brtags pa yi dpal kun tshang*// ma bos bde chen zhing 'ong bzhin// ma bsdus par yang yon tan 'du// sum rtsen sa la 'phos pa 'dra// nub kha'i mtshams sprin gsar pa mthong ba'i mod// nyin mor byed kyang bshol ba med par rgyug /ha cang dmar gsal mdzes pa ma yin yang*// sa spyod rnga yab sa 'dir bde bar 'dongs// dpyid kyi dpal mo mthong ba'i mod// ku hu'i rgyang klu len pa bzhin// dzi ba ka yi me tog la// bung ba'i tshogs rnams bde bar rol// sbrul ngan 'grogs pa dang bral zhing*// rang bzhin gyis ni mngar ba'i ro// 'dzad pa med par 'byin nus pa'i// dag byed gter 'di ngo mtshar rmad// rdza ri smug pos dmar ba dang*// ngur smrig bla gos bsgos pa'i 'od// nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dres pa la// 'byed nus blo ldan su zhig yod// ngo mtshar ltad mor g.yeng ba'i phyir// sngo bsangs bu mos mig stong du// sprul kyang ma ngoms ngo tsha nas// gzugs med khams su yibs la ltos/

(117) */ (118) */ (119)sa la khyad 'phags sa spyod zhing*// 'og min rgyal ba dgon zhes pa// ming dang don du mtshungs min zhes// rnam mkhyen gyis kyang dpyad pa 'dra// rdo rje'i lam la zhugs pa yi// nyams ltung rtsad nas sbyong ba'i thabs// 'gyod tshangs spyi khrus lam 'di ru// mi zhugs skal ldan su zhig yod// sgrub chen gral du mchis tsam gyis// mtshams med lnga yi sdig ltung yang*// shel dkar bzhin du dag pa la// som nyi'i gnas skabs nam zhig mchis// de slad yid ches dad pa yis// nyer drangs snyan ngag don yod phyir// bsngags brjod mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs 'khrol// mtsho byung ngag la zhugs min nam// dge tshogs mal+li ka yi 'od// ston zla gsar pa dang 'grogs ste// rnam mkhyen rgya mtshor phyin pa la// lha dang bcas pas mthun 'gyur mdzod// ces pa'ang smar shod rgyal ba dgon gyi sgrub gral du slebs skabs lag rtsed du 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros sam brda sprod kun bshad kyi bag chags 'jog pa'i btags ming sgra dbyangs pad+ma'i myu gus sug bris su bstar ba dge legs 'phel/// /
